方位介词:in front of / behind / between / ne: 描述物体相对位置的四个常用介词短语,注意 between 后接 and。
in front of 在…前面(外部)|behind 在…后面|between A and B 在 A 和 B 之间(两者)|among 用于三者及以上之间|next to / beside 在…旁边|in the front of 指"内部的前部"(如教室前排)
A cat is sitting in front of the door.
The garden is behind the house.
The bank is between the school and the park.
column3: 银行在学校和公园之间。
